trans-unit.source: View a test report so that you can find and correct any errors before you perform the actual posting of the journal or document.
trans-unit.target: Vis en kontrollrapport slik at du kan finne og rette eventuelle feil før du bokfører kladden eller dokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Test Report - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Test Report - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Release - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Release the document to the next stage of processing. You must reopen the document before you can make changes to it.
trans-unit.target: Frigi dokumentet til neste fase i behandlingen. Du må åpne dokumentet på nytt før du kan gjøre endringer i det.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Re&lease - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Re&lease - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reopen the document to change it after it has been approved. Approved documents have the Released status and must be opened before they can be changed.
trans-unit.target: Åpne dokumentet på nytt for å endre det etter at det har blitt godkjent. Godkjente dokumenter har statusen Frigitt, og de må åpnes før de kan endres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Re&open - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Re&open - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Reports - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action FinanceReports - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View an overview of when customer payments are due or overdue, divided into four periods. You must specify the date you want aging calculated from and the length of the period that each column will contain data for.
trans-unit.target: Vis en oversikt over når kundebetalinger forfaller eller er forfalt, delt inn i fire perioder. Du må angi datoen som du vil beregne aldersfordeling fra, og lengden på perioden som hver kolonne skal inneholde data for.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Aged Accounts Receivable - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Aged Accounts Receivable - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list with customers' payment history up until a certain date. You can use the report to extract your total sales income at the close of an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste med kunders betalingshistorikk frem til en bestemt dato. Du kan bruke rapporten til å trekke ut total salgsinntekt ved slutten av en regnskapsperiode eller et regnskapsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Balance to Date - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Balance to Date - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the balance for customers with balances on a specified date. The report can be used at the close of an accounting period, for example, or for an audit.
trans-unit.target: Vis saldoen for kunder med saldi på en bestemt dato. Rapporten kan for eksempel brukes i forbindelse med slutten av en regnskapsperiode eller revisjon.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Detail Trial Bal. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Detail Trial Bal. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or save a detailed list of each customer's total payments due, divided into three time periods. The report can be used to decide when to issue reminders, to evaluate a customer's creditworthiness, or to prepare liquidity analyses.
trans-unit.target: Vis, skriv ut eller lagre en detaljert liste over totale forfalte betalinger for hver kunde, delt inn i tre tidsperioder. Rapporten kan brukes til å bestemme når purringer skal utstedes, evaluere en kundes kredittverdighet eller foreta likviditetsanalyser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Detailed Aging - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Detailed Aging - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a document showing which customer ledger entries that a payment has been applied to. This report can be used as a payment receipt that you send to the customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis et dokument som viser hvilke kundeposter en betaling er utlignet mot. Denne rapporten kan brukes som en kvittering du sender til kunden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Payment Receipt - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Payment Receipt - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or save a summary of each customer's total payments due, divided into three time periods. The report can be used to decide when to issue reminders, to evaluate a customer's creditworthiness, or to prepare liquidity analyses.
trans-unit.target: Vis, skriv ut eller lagre et sammendrag av totale forfalte betalinger for hver kunde, delt inn i tre tidsperioder. Rapporten kan brukes til å bestemme når purringer skal utstedes, evaluere en kundes kredittverdighet eller foreta likviditetsanalyser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Summary Aging - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Summary Aging - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the beginning and ending balance for customers with entries within a specified period. The report can be used to verify that the balance for a customer posting group is equal to the balance on the corresponding general ledger account on a certain date.
trans-unit.target: Vis start- og sluttsaldoen for kunder med poster i en bestemt periode. Rapporten kan brukes til å bekrefte at saldoen for en bokføringsgruppe for kunde er lik saldoen på den tilsvarende finanskontoen på en bestemt dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of a customer's transactions for a selected period, for example, to send to the customer at the close of an accounting period. You can choose to have all overdue balances displayed regardless of the period specified, or you can choose to include an aging band.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over en kundes transaksjoner for en valgt periode, for eksempel for å sende til kunden ved slutten av en regnskapsperiode. Du kan velge å vise alle forfalte saldi, uavhengig av perioden du har angitt, eller du kan velge å vise en aldersfordeling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Report Statement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Report Statement - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action SalesReports - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View customer sales for a period, for example, to report sales activity to customs and tax authorities. You can choose to include only customers with total sales that exceed a minimum amount. You can also specify whether you want the report to show address details for each customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis kundesalg for en periode, for eksempel for å rapportere salgsaktivitet til toll- og avgiftsmyndigheter. Du kan velge å inkludere bare kunder med totalsalg som overstiger et minimumsbeløp. Du kan også angi om du vil at rapporten skal vise adresseopplysninger for hver kunde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Sales List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Sales List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View which customers purchase the most or owe the most in a selected period. Only customers that have either purchases during the period or a balance at the end of the period will be included.
trans-unit.target: Vis hvilke kunder som kjøper eller skylder mest, i en valgt periode. Bare kundene som har kjøp i perioden eller saldo ved slutten av perioden, vises i rapporten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Top 10 List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Credit Memos - Action Customer - Top 10 List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the customer's total cost, sale, and profit over time, for example, to analyze earnings trends. The report shows amounts for original and adjusted cost, sales, profit, invoice discount, payment discount, and profit percentage in three adjustable periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis kundens kostbeløp, salg og fortjeneste over tid, for eksempel for å analysere utviklingstendensen i inntjeningen. Rapporten viser beløp for opprinnelig og justert kost, salg, fortjeneste, fakturarabatt, kontantrabatt og fortjenesteprosent i tre justerbare perioder.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the currency of amounts on the sales document.

trans-unit.source: This invoice number is only used until posting. At that time, the posted sales invoice gets the final number that your customer will see.
trans-unit.target: Dette fakturanummeret brukes bare frem til bokføring. På det tidspunktet får den bokførte salgsfakturaen det endelige nummeret som kunden vil se.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Control No. - Property AboutText)

trans-unit.target: Du bokfører en faktura når du har fullført alle opplysningene. Denne handlingen bokfører den valgte fakturaen, og du kan sende den til kunden senere hvis det er nødvendig.

trans-unit.source: Release the document to the next stage of processing. You must reopen the document before you can make changes to it.
trans-unit.target: Frigi dokumentet til neste fase i behandlingen. Du må åpne dokumentet på nytt før du kan gjøre endringer i det.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Re&lease - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Re&lease - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reopen the document to change it after it has been approved. Approved documents have the Released status and must be opened before they can be changed.
trans-unit.target: Åpne dokumentet på nytt for å endre det etter at det har blitt godkjent. Godkjente dokumenter har statusen Frigitt, og de må åpnes før de kan endres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Re&open - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: View an overview of when customer payments are due or overdue, divided into four periods. You must specify the date you want aging calculated from and the length of the period that each column will contain data for.
trans-unit.target: Vis en oversikt over når kundebetalinger forfaller eller er forfalt, delt inn i fire perioder. Du må angi datoen som du vil beregne aldersfordeling fra, og lengden på perioden som hver kolonne skal inneholde data for.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Aged Accounts Receivable - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Aged Accounts Receivable - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list with customers' payment history up until a certain date. You can use the report to extract your total sales income at the close of an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste med kunders betalingshistorikk frem til en bestemt dato. Du kan bruke rapporten til å trekke ut total salgsinntekt ved slutten av en regnskapsperiode eller et regnskapsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Balance to Date - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Balance to Date - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the balance for customers with balances on a specified date. The report can be used at the close of an accounting period, for example, or for an audit.
trans-unit.target: Vis saldoen for kunder med saldi på en bestemt dato. Rapporten kan for eksempel brukes i forbindelse med slutten av en regnskapsperiode eller revisjon.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Detail Trial Bal. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Detail Trial Bal. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or save a detailed list of each customer's total payments due, divided into three time periods. The report can be used to decide when to issue reminders, to evaluate a customer's creditworthiness, or to prepare liquidity analyses.
trans-unit.target: Vis, skriv ut eller lagre en detaljert liste over totale forfalte betalinger for hver kunde, delt inn i tre tidsperioder. Rapporten kan brukes til å bestemme når purringer skal utstedes, evaluere en kundes kredittverdighet eller foreta likviditetsanalyser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Detailed Aging - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Detailed Aging - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a document showing which customer ledger entries that a payment has been applied to. This report can be used as a payment receipt that you send to the customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis et dokument som viser hvilke kundeposter en betaling er utlignet mot. Denne rapporten kan brukes som en kvittering du sender til kunden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Payment Receipt - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Payment Receipt - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or save a summary of each customer's total payments due, divided into three time periods. The report can be used to decide when to issue reminders, to evaluate a customer's creditworthiness, or to prepare liquidity analyses.
trans-unit.target: Vis, skriv ut eller lagre et sammendrag av totale forfalte betalinger for hver kunde, delt inn i tre tidsperioder. Rapporten kan brukes til å bestemme når purringer skal utstedes, evaluere en kundes kredittverdighet eller foreta likviditetsanalyser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Summary Aging - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Summary Aging - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the beginning and ending balance for customers with entries within a specified period. The report can be used to verify that the balance for a customer posting group is equal to the balance on the corresponding general ledger account on a certain date.
trans-unit.target: Vis start- og sluttsaldoen for kunder med poster i en bestemt periode. Rapporten kan brukes til å bekrefte at saldoen for en bokføringsgruppe for kunde er lik saldoen på den tilsvarende finanskontoen på en bestemt dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of a customer's transactions for a selected period, for example, to send to the customer at the close of an accounting period. You can choose to have all overdue balances displayed regardless of the period specified, or you can choose to include an aging band.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over en kundes transaksjoner for en valgt periode, for eksempel for å sende til kunden ved slutten av en regnskapsperiode. Du kan velge å vise alle forfalte saldi, uavhengig av perioden du har angitt, eller du kan velge å vise en aldersfordeling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Report Statement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Report Statement - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action SalesReports - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View customer sales for a period, for example, to report sales activity to customs and tax authorities. You can choose to include only customers with total sales that exceed a minimum amount. You can also specify whether you want the report to show address details for each customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis kundesalg for en periode, for eksempel for å rapportere salgsaktivitet til toll- og avgiftsmyndigheter. Du kan velge å inkludere bare kunder med totalsalg som overstiger et minimumsbeløp. Du kan også angi om du vil at rapporten skal vise adresseopplysninger for hver kunde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Sales List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Sales List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View which customers purchase the most or owe the most in a selected period. Only customers that have either purchases during the period or a balance at the end of the period will be included.
trans-unit.target: Vis hvilke kunder som kjøper eller skylder mest, i en valgt periode. Bare kundene som har kjøp i perioden eller saldo ved slutten av perioden, vises i rapporten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Top 10 List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Customer - Top 10 List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the customer's total cost, sale, and profit over time, for example, to analyze earnings trends. The report shows amounts for original and adjusted cost, sales, profit, invoice discount, payment discount, and profit percentage in three adjustable periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis kundens kostbeløp, salg og fortjeneste over tid, for eksempel for å analysere utviklingstendensen i inntjeningen. Rapporten viser beløp for opprinnelig og justert kost, salg, fortjeneste, fakturarabatt, kontantrabatt og fortjenesteprosent i tre justerbare perioder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Sales Statistics - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice List - Action Sales Statistics - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: This action is only available for lines that have Allocation Account set as Type.
trans-unit.target: Denne handlingen er bare tilgjengelig for linjer der tildelingskonto er valgt som type.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - NamedType ActionOnlyAllowedForAllocationAccountsErr)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the allocation account number that will be used to distribute the amounts during the posting process.
trans-unit.target: Angir tildelingskontonummeret som skal brukes til å distribuere beløpene under bokføringsprosessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Allocation Account No. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Allocation Account No. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the invoice line is included when the invoice discount is calculated.
trans-unit.target: Angir om fakturalinjen er inkludert når fakturarabatten beregnes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Allow Invoice Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you can assign item charges to this line.
trans-unit.target: Angir at du kan tilordne varegebyr til denne linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Allow Item Charge Assignment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied from.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret for vareposten som dokumentet eller kladdelinjen er hentet fra.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Appl.-from Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied -to.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret for vareposten som dokumentet eller kladdelinjen er brukt for.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.
trans-unit.target: Angir hyllen der varene plukkes eller plasseres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order line that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret på rammebestillingslinjen som posten stammer fra.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Blanket Order Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret på rammeordren som posten stammer fra.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Blanket Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the deferral template that governs how revenue earned with this sales document is deferred to the different accounting periods when the good or service was delivered.
trans-unit.target: Angir malen for periodisering som styrer hvordan inntekter fra dette salgsdokumentet periodiseres til de ulike regnskapsperiodene når varen eller servicen ble levert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Deferral Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if depreciation was calculated until the FA posting date of the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir om avskrivning ble beregnet til aktivabokføringsdatoen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Depr. until FA Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the depreciation book to which the line will be posted if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for avskrivningstablået som linjen skal bokføres i hvis du har valgt Aktiva i feltet Type for denne linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Depreciation Book Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of what you are selling. Based on your choices in the Type and No. fields, the field may show suggested text that you can change it for this document. To add a comment, set the Type field to Comment and write the comment itself here.
trans-unit.target: Angir en beskrivelse av hva du selger. Basert på valgene i feltene Type og Nr. kan feltet vise foreslått tekst som du kan endre for dette dokumentet. Hvis du vil legge til en kommentar, velger du Merknad for typefeltet og skriver selve merknaden her.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.
trans-unit.target: Angir informasjon i tillegg til beskrivelsen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Document No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a depreciation book code if you want the journal line to be posted to that depreciation book, as well as to the depreciation book in the Depreciation Book Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angir en avskrivningstablåkode hvis du vil at kladdelinjen skal bokføres i det avskrivningstablået, i tillegg til i avskrivningstablået i feltet Avskrivningstablåkode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Duplicate in Depreciation Book - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that will be used on related fixed asset ledger entries.
trans-unit.target: Angir datoen som skal brukes på relaterte aktivaposter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control FA Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of transaction that will be posted with the document line. If you select Comment, then you can enter any text in the Description field, such as a message to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angir transaksjonstypen som skal bokføres med dokumentlinjen. Hvis du velger Merknad, kan du angi tekst i feltet Beskrivelse, for eksempel en melding til en kunde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's or customer's trade type to link transactions made for this business partner with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angir leverandørens eller kundens handelstype for å koble transaksjoner gjort for denne forretningspartneren, med riktig finanskonto i henhold til det generelle bokføringsoppsettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Gen. Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angir varens produkttype for å koble transaksjoner gjort for denne varen, med riktig finanskonto i henhold til det generelle bokføringsoppsettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Gen. Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the gross weight on the line is included in the total gross weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angir bruttovekten for én enhet av varen. I salgsstatistikkvinduet er bruttovekten på linjen inkludert i den totale bruttovekten av alle linjene for det bestemte salgsdokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for den konserninterne partneren som transaksjonen er relatert til hvis posten ble opprettet fra en konsernintern transaksjon.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control IC Partner Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item or account in your IC partner's company that corresponds to the item or account on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir varen eller kontoen i KI-partnerselskapet som tilsvarer varen eller kontoen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control IC Partner Ref. Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the IC partner. If the line is being sent to one of your intercompany partners, this field is used together with the IC Partner Ref. Type field to indicate the item or account in your partner's company that corresponds to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir KI-partneren. Hvis linjen sendes til en av de konserninterne partnerne, brukes dette feltet sammen med feltet Referansetype for KI-partner til å angi varen eller kontoen i partnerens firma som tilsvarer linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control IC Partner Reference - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the invoice discount amount for the line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Inv. Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the referenced item number. If you enter a cross reference between yours and your vendor's or customer's item number, then this number will override the standard item number when you enter the reference number on a sales or purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angir varens referansenummer. Hvis du oppgir en kryssreferanse mellom ditt og leverandørens eller kundens varenummer, vil dette nummeret overstyre standardvarenummeret når du oppgir referansenummeret i et salgs- eller kjøpsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Item Reference No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the entry number of the project planning line that the sales line is linked to.
trans-unit.target: Angir postnummeret for prosjektplanleggingslinjen som salgslinjen er koblet til.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Job Contract Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project. If you fill in this field and the Project Task No. field, then a project ledger entry will be posted together with the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret for det relaterte prosjektet. Hvis du fyller ut dette feltet og feltet Prosjektoppgavenr., bokføres det deretter en prosjektpost sammen med salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project task.
trans-unit.target: Angir nummeret for den relaterte prosjektoppgaven.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Job Task No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net amount, excluding any invoice discount amount, that must be paid for products on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir nettobeløpet, minus fakturarabattbeløp, som skal betales for produktene på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir rabattprosenten som blir gitt for varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir rabattbeløpet som blir gitt for varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Line Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that there is a specific discount for this customer.
trans-unit.target: Angir at det finnes en bestemt rabatt for denne kunden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control LineDiscExists - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control LineDiscExists - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the inventory location from which the items sold should be picked and where the inventory decrease is registered.
trans-unit.target: Angir beholdningslokasjonen som de solgte varene skal plukkes fra, og hvor beholdningsreduksjonen registreres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angir nettovekten for én enhet av varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistikk er nettovekten på linjen inkludert i den totale nettovekten av alle linjene for det bestemte salgsdokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies what you're selling. The options vary, depending on what you choose in the Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angir hva du selger. Alternativene varierer avhengig av hva du valgte i feltet Type.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that this item is a catalog item.
trans-unit.target: Angir at denne varen er en katalogvare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Nonstock - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that there is a specific price for this customer.
trans-unit.target: Angir at det finnes en bestemt pris for denne kunden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control PriceExists - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control PriceExists - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item charge that was assigned to a specified item when you posted this sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir antallet av varegebyret som ble tilordnet til en bestemt vare da du bokførte salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Qty. Assigned - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item charge will be assigned to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter av varegebyret som skal tilordnes linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Qty. to Assign - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units are being sold.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter som selges.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code explaining why the item was returned.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden som forklarer hvorfor varen ble returnert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Return Reason Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the shipping agent who is transporting the items.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for transportøren som transporterer varene.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Shipping Agent Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the service, such as a one-day delivery, that is offered by the shipping agent.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for servicen, for eksempel levering samme dag, som tilbys av transportøren.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Shipping Agent Service Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden til Snarveisdimensjon 1, som er én av to globale dimensjonskoder som du har definert i vinduet Finansoppsett.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax area that is used to calculate and post sales tax.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT category in connection with electronic document sending. For example, when you send sales documents through the PEPPOL service, the value in this field is used to populate several fields, such as the ClassifiedTaxCategory element in the Item group. It is also used to populate the TaxCategory element in both the TaxSubtotal and AllowanceCharge group. The number is based on the UNCL5305 standard.
trans-unit.target: Angir mva-kategorien i forbindelse med sending av elektroniske dokumenter. Når du for eksempel sender salgsdokumenter via PEPPOL-servicen, brukes verdien i dette feltet til å fylle ut flere felt, for eksempel elementet ClassifiedTaxCategory i gruppen Item. Den brukes også til å fylle ut elementet TaxCategory i både gruppen TaxSubtotal og AllowanceCharge. Nummeret er basert på UNCL5305-standarden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Tax Category - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax group that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angi mva-gruppen som brukes til å beregne og bokføre salgsmva.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Tax Group Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the customer or vendor is liable for sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angir om kunden eller leverandøren er salgsmva-pliktig.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of entity that will be posted for this sales line, such as Item, Resource, or G/L Account.
trans-unit.target: Angir enhetstypen som skal bokføres for denne salgslinjen, for eksempel vare, ressurs eller finanskonto.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit cost of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir enhetskosten for varen på linjen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit of measure for the item or resource on the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir enheten for varen eller ressursen på salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvordan hver enhet av varen eller ressursen måles, for eksempel i stykk eller i timer. Verdien i feltet Lagerenhet på varen eller ressurskortet settes inn som standard.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price for one unit on the sales line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the volume of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the volume of one unit of the item on the line is included in the total volume of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angir volumet for én enhet av varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistikk er volumet på én enhet av varen på linjen inkludert i totalvolumet av alle linjene for det bestemte salgsdokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Unit Volume - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the sales statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular sales document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir varianten av varen på linjen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's VAT specification to link transactions made for this vendor with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

trans-unit.source: Specifies which work type the resource applies to when the sale is related to a project.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Invoice Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Angir en rabattprosent som blir brukt på fakturaen, basert på salgslinjer der feltet Tillat fakturarabatt er valgt. Prosenten og kriteriene er definert på siden Kundefakturarabatter, men du kan angi eller endre prosenten manuelt.

trans-unit.target: Angir et rabattbeløp som blir trukket fra verdien i feltet Totalt inkl. mva., basert på salgslinjer der feltet Tillat fakturarabatt er valgt. Du kan angi eller endre beløpet manuelt.

trans-unit.source: Add a line for each component on the bill of materials for the selected item. For example, this is useful for selling the parent item as a kit. CAUTION: The line for the parent item will be deleted and only its description will display. To undo this action, delete the component lines and add a line for the parent item again. This action is available only for lines that contain an item.
trans-unit.target: Legg til en linje for hver komponent på stykklisten for den valgte varen. Dette er for eksempel nyttig hvis du vil selge den overordnede varen som et sett. Forsiktig! Linjen for den overordnede varen slettes og bare beskrivelsen vises. Hvis du vil angre denne handlingen, må du slette komponentlinjene og legge til en linje for den overordnede varen på nytt. Denne handlingen er bare tilgjengelig for linjer som inneholder en vare.

Hvis kunden ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato, beregner programmet om varene blir tilgjengelige for levering på denne datoen. Hvis varene er tilgjengelige, vil den planlagte leveringsdatoen være den samme som den anmodede leveringsdatoen. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet datoen som varene er tilgjengelige fra, og angir denne datoen i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Order Subform - Control Planned Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the shipment should ship from the warehouse. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates the planned shipment date by subtracting the shipping time from the requested delivery date. If the customer does not request a delivery date or the requested delivery date cannot be met, the program calculates the content of this field by adding the shipment time to the shipping date.
trans-unit.target: Angir datoen da forsendelsen skal sendes fra lageret. Hvis kunden ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato, beregner programmet den planlagte forsendelsesdatoen ved å trekke leveringstiden fra den anmodede leveringsdatoen. Hvis kunden ikke ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato eller den anmodede leveringsdatoen ikke kan oppfylles, beregner programmet innholdet i dette feltet ved å legge leveringstiden til leveringsdatoen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Order Subform - Control Planned Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the prepayment percentage to use to calculate the prepayment for sales.

trans-unit.source: While preparing a quote it's status is *Open*. When it's ready, you can change the status to *Released* to reserve the items or services you're selling. To change a released quote you'll need to reopen it.

trans-unit.source: Specifies that this item is a catalog item.
trans-unit.target: Angir at denne varen er en katalogvare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Nonstock - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angir den planlagte datoen da forsendelsen blir levert til kundens adresse. Hvis kunden ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato, beregner programmet om varene blir tilgjengelige for levering på denne datoen. Hvis varene er tilgjengelige, vil den planlagte leveringsdatoen være den samme som den anmodede leveringsdatoen. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet datoen som varene er tilgjengelige fra, og angir denne datoen i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Planned Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the shipment should ship from the warehouse. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates the planned shipment date by subtracting the shipping time from the requested delivery date. If the customer does not request a delivery date or the requested delivery date cannot be met, the program calculates the content of this field by adding the shipment time to the shipping date.
trans-unit.target: Angir datoen da forsendelsen skal sendes fra lageret. Hvis kunden ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato, beregner programmet den planlagte forsendelsesdatoen ved å trekke leveringstiden fra den anmodede leveringsdatoen. Hvis kunden ikke ber om å få oppgitt en leveringsdato eller den anmodede leveringsdatoen ikke kan oppfylles, beregner programmet innholdet i dette feltet ved å legge leveringstiden til leveringsdatoen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Planned Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you have promised to deliver the order, as a result of the Order Promising function.
trans-unit.target: Angir datoen da du har lovet å levere ordren som et resultat av funksjonen Ordrebekreftelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Promised Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item charge that was assigned to a specified item when you posted this sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir antallet av varegebyret som ble tilordnet til en bestemt vare da du bokførte salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Qty. Assigned - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item charge will be assigned to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter av varegebyret som skal tilordnes linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Qty. to Assign - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that remains to be invoiced. It is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angir antallet som ikke er fakturert ennå. Det blir beregnet som Antall - Ant. fakturert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Qty. to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units are being returned.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter som returneres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter av varen på linjen som allerede er bokført som fakturert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Quantity Invoiced - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the customer has asked for the order to be delivered.
trans-unit.target: Angir på hvilken dato kunden har bedt om at ordren skal leveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Requested Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as shipped.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange enheter av varen på linjen som allerede er bokført som levert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. Received - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of items that remain to be shipped.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor mange varer som fortsatt ikke er levert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: If the customer is not returning the full quantity, adjust the ‘Qty. to Receive’ value. Similarly, choose the quantity to credit the customer in the Qty to Invoice field.
trans-unit.target: Hvis kunden ikke returnerer hele antallet, justerer du verdien Motta (antall). På samme måte velger du antallet for å kreditere kunden i feltet Fakturer (antall).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property AboutText)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code explaining why the item was returned.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden som forklarer hvorfor varen ble returnert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Reason Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the starting date of the returns deferral period.
trans-unit.target: Angir startdatoen for periodiseringsperioden for returer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Returns Deferral Start Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies when items on the document are shipped or were shipped. A shipment date is usually calculated from a requested delivery date plus lead time.
trans-unit.target: Angir om varer i dokumentet skal leveres eller er levert. En leveringsdato beregnes vanligvis fra en ønsket leveringsdato pluss leveringstid.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the shipping agent who is transporting the items.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for transportøren som transporterer varene.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipping Agent Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the service, such as a one-day delivery, that is offered by the shipping agent.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden for servicen, for eksempel levering samme dag, som tilbys av transportøren.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipping Agent Service Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how long it takes from when the items are shipped from the warehouse to when they are delivered.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvor lang tid det tar fra varene leveres fra lageret til de er levert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipping Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden til Snarveisdimensjon 1, som er én av to globale dimensjonskoder som du har definert i vinduet Finansoppsett.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angir koden til Snarveisdimensjon 2, som er én av to globale dimensjonskoder som du har definert i vinduet Finansoppsett.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 3.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode3 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 4.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode4 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 5.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode5 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 6.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode6 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 7.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode7 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 8.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode8 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax area code for the customer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Area Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax group that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angi mva-gruppen som brukes til å beregne og bokføre salgsmva.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Group Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the customer or vendor is liable for sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angir om kunden eller leverandøren er salgsmva-pliktig.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Liable - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of entity that will be posted for this sales line, such as Item, Resource, or G/L Account.
trans-unit.target: Angir enhetstypen som skal bokføres for denne salgslinjen, for eksempel vare, ressurs eller finanskonto.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit cost of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir enhetskosten for varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit of measure for the item or resource on the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir enheten for varen eller ressursen på salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angir hvordan hver enhet av varen eller ressursen måles, for eksempel i stykk eller i timer. Verdien i feltet Lagerenhet på varen eller ressurskortet settes inn som standard.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price for one unit on the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angir salgsprisen for én enhet på salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the volume of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the volume of one unit of the item on the line is included in the total volume of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angir volumet for én enhet av varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistikk er volumet på én enhet av varen på linjen inkludert i totalvolumet av alle linjene for det bestemte salgsdokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Volume - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the sales statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angir antall enheter per kolli for varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistikk inngår linjens antall per kolli i summeringen av antall per kolli for alle linjene i det aktuelle salgsdokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Units per Parcel - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angir varianten av varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's VAT specification to link transactions made for this vendor with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angir leverandørens mva-spesifikasjon for å koble transaksjoner gjort for denne leverandøren, med riktig finanskonto i henhold til det generelle mva-bokføringsoppsettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control VAT Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT product posting group. Links business transactions made for the item, resource, or G/L account with the general ledger, to account for VAT amounts resulting from trade with that record.
trans-unit.target: Angir mva-bokføringsgruppen - vare. Kobler forretningstransaksjoner som er utført for varen, ressursen eller finanskontoen, med Finans for å gjenspeile mva-beløpene fra handel med den posten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angir summen av verdien i feltet Linjebeløp ekskl. MVA på alle linjer i dokumentet, minus eventuelle rabattbeløp i feltet Fakturarabattbeløp.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Excl. VAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Excl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Incl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angir summen av verdien i feltet Linjebeløp inkl. MVA på alle linjer i dokumentet, minus eventuelle rabattbeløp i feltet Fakturarabattbeløp.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of VAT amounts on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angir summen av mva-beløpene på alle linjene i dokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount percentage that is applied to the invoice, based on sales lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. The percentage and criteria are defined in the Customer Invoice Discounts page, but you can enter or change the percentage manually.
trans-unit.target: Angir en rabattprosent som blir brukt på fakturaen, basert på salgslinjer der feltet Tillat fakturarabatt er valgt. Prosenten og kriteriene er definert på siden Kundefakturarabatter, men du kan angi eller endre prosenten manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount amount that is deducted from the value of the Total Incl. VAT field, based on sales lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. You can enter or change the amount manually.
trans-unit.target: Angir et rabattbeløp som blir trukket fra verdien i feltet Totalt inkl. mva., basert på salgslinjer der feltet Tillat fakturarabatt er valgt. Du kan angi eller endre beløpet manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angir summen av verdien i feltet Linjebeløp ekskl. mva på alle linjer i dokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control SubtotalExclVAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control SubtotalExclVAT - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action &Line - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or add comments for the record.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller legg til merknader for posten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Comments - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Comments - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit the deferral schedule that governs how revenue made with this sales document is deferred to different accounting periods when the document is posted.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger tidsplanen for periodisering som styrer hvordan inntekter fra dette salgsdokumentet periodiseres til ulike regnskapsperioder når dokumentet bokføres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DeferralSchedule - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DeferralSchedule - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit dimensions, such as area, project, or department, that you can assign to sales and purchase documents to distribute costs and analyze transaction history.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger dimensjoner, for eksempel område, prosjekt eller avdeling, som du kan tilordne til salgs- og kjøpsdokumenter for å distribuere kostnader og analysere transaksjonshistorikk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Dimensions - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Dimensions - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Add a file as an attachment. You can attach images as well as documents.
trans-unit.target: Legg til en fil som vedlegg. Du kan legge ved bilder og dokumenter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DocAttach - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DocAttach - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View related open, posted, or archived documents or document lines.
trans-unit.target: Vis relaterte åpne, bokførte eller arkiverte dokumenter eller dokumentlinjer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DocumentLineTracking - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action DocumentLineTracking - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Item Availability by - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View availability figures for items on bills of materials that show how many units of a parent item you can make based on the availability of child items.
trans-unit.target: Vis tilgjengelighetstall for stykklistevarer som angir hvor mange enheter av en overordnet vare du kan lage basert på tilgjengeligheten av underordnede varer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action BOM Level - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action BOM Level - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View how the actual and the projected available balance of an item will develop over time according to supply and demand events.
trans-unit.target: Vis hvordan den faktiske og beregnede disponible beholdningen av en vare vil utvikle seg over tid i henhold til tilbud og etterspørsel.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Event - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Event - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the actual and projected quantity of the item per location.
trans-unit.target: Vis faktisk og beregnet antall av varen per lokasjon.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Location - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Location - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the current and projected quantity of the item in each lot.
trans-unit.target: Vis gjeldende og beregnet antall av varen i hvert parti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Lot - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Lot - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Show the projected quantity of the item over time according to time periods, such as day, week, or month.
trans-unit.target: Viser beregnet antall av varen over tid i henhold til tidsperioder, for eksempel dag, uke eller måned.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Period - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Period - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit the item's variants. Instead of setting up each color of an item as a separate item, you can set up the various colors as variants of the item.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger varens varianter. Du kan definere de ulike fargene som varianter av varen i stedet for å definere hver variant som en egen vare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Variant - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Variant - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record additional direct costs, for example for freight. This action is available only for Charge (Item) line types.
trans-unit.target: Registrer flere direkte kostnader, for eksempel frakt. Denne handlingen er bare tilgjengelig for linjetypene Gebyr (vare).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Item Charge &Assignment - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Item Charge &Assignment - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit serial, lot and package numbers for the selected item. This action is available only for lines that contain an item.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger serie-, parti- og pakkenumre for den valgte varen. Denne handlingen er bare tilgjengelig for linjer som inneholder en vare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ItemTrackingLines - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ItemTrackingLines - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Errors - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View all sales lines, including lines with and without issues.
trans-unit.target: Vis alle salgslinjer, inkludert linjer med og uten problemer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ShowAllLines - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ShowAllLines - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of sales lines that have issues before you post the document.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over salgslinjer som har problemer, før du bokfører dokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ShowLinesWithErrors - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action ShowLinesWithErrors - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action F&unctions - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Attach the selected non-inventory product lines to a inventory item line in this sales return order.
trans-unit.target: Knytt de valgte ikke-beholdningsproduktlinjene til en beholdningsvarelinje i denne ordrereturen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Attach to Inventory Item Line - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Attach to Inventory Item Line - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Add a line for each component on the bill of materials for the selected item. For example, this is useful for selling the parent item as a kit. CAUTION: The line for the parent item will be deleted and only its description will display. To undo this action, delete the component lines and add a line for the parent item again. This action is available only for lines that contain an item.
trans-unit.target: Legg til en linje for hver komponent på stykklisten for den valgte varen. Dette er for eksempel nyttig hvis du vil selge den overordnede varen som et sett. Forsiktig! Linjen for den overordnede varen slettes og bare beskrivelsen vises. Hvis du vil angre denne handlingen, må du slette komponentlinjene og legge til en linje for den overordnede varen på nytt. Denne handlingen er bare tilgjengelig for linjer som inneholder en vare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action E&xplode BOM - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action E&xplode BOM - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Insert the extended item description that is set up for the item that is being processed on the line.
trans-unit.target: Sett inn den utvidede varebeskrivelsen som er definert for varen som blir behandlet på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Action Insert &Ext. Texts - Property ToolTip)

To create a new invoice with the same information, use the Copy function. When you copy an invoice, remember to post shipments for the new invoice.
trans-unit.target: Tilbakefør denne bokførte fakturaen. Det opprettes en kreditnota som samsvares med fakturaen, og fakturaen annulleres. Følgesedler for fakturaen blir tilbakeført. Hvis du vil opprette en ny faktura med samme informasjon, bruker du kopieringsfunksjonen. Når du kopierer en faktura, må du huske å bokføre følgesedler for den nye fakturaen.

trans-unit.source: If you have to make adjustments to this invoice, you can post a correction or cancel the invoice entirely. In both cases, a credit memo is created to represent the adjustment you make.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du må foreta justeringer i fakturaen, kan du bokføre en korrigering eller annullere fakturaen fullstendig. I begge tilfeller opprettes det en kreditnota for å representere justeringen du foretar.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the sales statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular sales document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoice Subform - Action DocAttach - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create and post a sales credit memo that reverses this posted sales invoice. This posted sales invoice will be canceled.
trans-unit.target: Opprett og bokfør en salgskreditnota som tilbakefører denne bokførte salgsfakturaen. Denne bokførte salgsfakturaen vil bli annullert.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoices - Action CancelInvoice - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoices - Action CancelInvoice - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reverse this posted invoice. A credit memo will be created and matched with the invoice, and the invoice will be canceled. Shipments for the invoice will be reversed. To create a new invoice with the same information, use the Copy function. When you copy an invoice, remember to post shipments for the new invoice.
trans-unit.target: Tilbakefør denne bokførte fakturaen. Det opprettes en kreditnota som samsvares med fakturaen, og fakturaen annulleres. Følgesedler for fakturaen blir tilbakeført. Hvis du vil opprette en ny faktura med samme informasjon, bruker du kopieringsfunksjonen. Når du kopierer en faktura, må du huske å bokføre følgesedler for den nye fakturaen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoices - Action CorrectInvoice - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoices - Action CorrectInvoice - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create a credit memo for this posted invoice that you complete and post manually to reverse the posted invoice.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Sales Invoices - Action CreateCreditMemo - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the posted sales credit memo that was created when you canceled the posted sales invoice. If the posted sales invoice is the result of a canceled sales credit memo, then the canceled sales credit memo will open.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.
